newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three diesel diffs steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three diesel diffs steady.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three diesel fuel differentials were steady on Thursday but spot agricultural demand could emerge in the coming days, traders said.
"We're drying out," one Group Three trader said of agricultural demand expect to emerge with warmer, drier weather in the region.

Group Three low sulphur differentials were talked 5.75/6.0 cents a gallon over NYMEX May heating oil for prompt deliveries and 5.25/5.50 cents over for later barrels, traders said. High sulphur was bid 4.75 cents over the print.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was talked 3.75/4.0 cents a gallon over the print for April deliveries, with high sulphur 1.75/2.0 cents over the print.
"I think that's the story there. (Diesel differentials) have been steady," a Midwest trader said.
Group Three unleaded for prompt and later April deliveries was bid 0.25 cent a gallon under NYMEX May unleaded, with premium steady at 3.50 cents higher.
Chicago unleaded was bid 0.25 cent a gallon over the print, with premium barrels steady at 5.50 cents a gallon higher.
